title: Book Two · Chapter 53: A Page Face Down
story:
On Thursday, warm air comes through the classroom window. After school, Ronan takes a book from the low shelf at home. It is the old book with the red sail on its cover.

He sits near the green door. The black cat comes into the yard and walks past his shoe. Ronan puts one finger under the first line.

He knows this page. A boy looks for a small boat. The boat is near a wall. Ronan reads quickly and turns the book over.

“I can tell it now,” he says to the cat.

The cat sits down with its back to him.

“The boy goes to the river. He finds his boat there.”

Ronan stops. Does the boy go to the river first? He can see water in his head. He cannot see the line on the page.

He opens the book. The boy goes to the yard first. His sister tells him about the boat near the wall. The picture shows water in the distance, behind the houses.

Ronan turns the book over again.

“The boy goes to the yard. His sister tells him about the boat.”

The cat washes one foot.

“You are a very quiet teacher,” Ronan says.

Dad comes through the gate. He puts his work bag down. The book is face down on Ronan's knees. Dad looks at it.

“Is it sleeping?”

“I am trying to remember the story.”

“Shall I ask a question?”

Ronan nods.

“Where is the boat?”

“Near the wall.”

“Who tells the boy?”

“His sister.”

Dad lifts his hands. “That is all I can ask without the page.”

Ronan gives him the book. Dad reads slowly. His finger stops at a word. Ronan knows it today and says it. Dad tries the sound. Then he reads the whole line.

They change places. Ronan asks one question. Dad answers. Ronan opens the book and checks Dad's answer.

Mum calls from the kitchen. Dad stands up for water. Ronan leaves the book open on the chair and follows him.

Later, Ronan puts the book back on the low shelf. Tomorrow's story will be different. This old story will not give him the answers.

He finds his pencil and checks the point. Then he puts it inside his bag. There is still time before supper. In the yard, the cat chases a dry leaf across the stones. Ronan rolls a second leaf toward it. The cat ignores his leaf and runs after the first one again.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

face down＝正面朝下；yard＝院子；boat＝小船。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan练习时为什么把书扣下？
2. 他发现什么内容记错了？

## 读句子

**The cat / washes / one foot.** 那只猫／清洗／一只脚。
